summary: Losartan carries the strongest type of official warning because it can cause injury or death to an unborn baby if taken during pregnancy [3][7]. Warnings also note that it can cause hypotension, which means low blood pressure, and requires monitoring of kidney function and potassium levels [7]. Additionally, a small computer model rather than human testing gave the drug high risk scores for liver and heart problems [M]. Similar drugs also carry warnings regarding harm to unborn babies and heart harm [4][5][6].
